quote_segments: Table 4 Article 342 was revised to correlate with the trade sizes between IMC, RMC
and EMT. It also correlates with the action taken on Public Comment 1209 for 342.20(B).

notes: Third-party Table 4 copies are banned as sources (PDHonline's 'EMT' block is the IMC block).
Do not build a conduit-fill tool on this file alone: EMT, PVC, RMC, FMC and Table 5 are unverified.
